entries.example: 我們在公園架設了一個大螢幕。
entries.exampleEnglish: We set up a big screen in the park.
entries.question: 你自己架設過網站嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever set up a website yourself?
entries.answer: 架設過，我幫朋友的咖啡廳架設了網站。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I set up a website for my friend's café.

entries.example: 我每天搭捷運通勤。
entries.exampleEnglish: I commute by MRT every day.
entries.question: 你每天通勤要多久？
entries.questionEnglish: How long is your commute every day?
entries.answer: 我通勤大概要四十分鐘。
entries.answerEnglish: My commute takes about forty minutes.

entries.example: 那家餐廳開了一年就破產了。
entries.exampleEnglish: That restaurant went bankrupt after just one year.
entries.question: 你覺得在台北開餐廳容易破產嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think it's easy to go bankrupt running a restaurant in Taipei?
entries.answer: 很容易，房租太貴，很多店都破產了。
entries.answerEnglish: Very easy. Rent is too high, and lots of shops have gone bankrupt.

entries.example: 他從小就開始學中國武術。
entries.exampleEnglish: He started learning Chinese martial arts as a child.
entries.question: 你想學什麼武術？
entries.questionEnglish: What martial art would you like to learn?
entries.answer: 我想學太極拳，它是一種很慢的武術。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to learn tai chi; it's a very slow martial art.

entries.example: 我爸很頑固，都不聽別人的意見。
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad is very stubborn; he never listens to other people's opinions.
entries.question: 你家誰最頑固？
entries.questionEnglish: Who is the most stubborn person in your family?
entries.answer: 我爺爺最頑固，他從來不肯用手機。
entries.answerEnglish: My grandpa is the most stubborn; he refuses to ever use a phone.

entries.example: 我們兩個同時到了餐廳。
entries.exampleEnglish: The two of us got to the restaurant at the same time.
entries.question: 你可以同時做兩件事嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you do two things at the same time?
entries.answer: 可以，我常常同時聽音樂跟工作。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often listen to music and work at the same time.

entries.example: 他搬去國外以後，跟老朋友漸漸疏遠了。
entries.exampleEnglish: After he moved abroad, he gradually drifted apart from his old friends.
entries.question: 你覺得朋友為什麼會疏遠？
entries.questionEnglish: Why do you think friends drift apart?
entries.answer: 太久沒聯絡，朋友就會慢慢疏遠。
entries.answerEnglish: If you don't keep in touch for too long, friends slowly drift apart.

entries.example: 我奶奶有關節炎，下雨天膝蓋會痛。
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma has arthritis; her knees hurt on rainy days.
entries.question: 關節炎常常發生在什麼人身上？
entries.questionEnglish: Who usually gets arthritis?
entries.answer: 關節炎常常發生在年紀大的人身上。
entries.answerEnglish: Arthritis usually affects older people.

entries.example: 我們去吃大餐，紀念結婚十週年。
entries.exampleEnglish: We went out for a big meal to mark our tenth wedding anniversary.
entries.question: 你會怎麼紀念自己的生日？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you mark your birthday?
entries.answer: 我會跟朋友去旅行，紀念我的生日。
entries.answerEnglish: I go on a trip with friends to celebrate my birthday.

entries.example: 對不起，我誤解你的意思了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Sorry, I misunderstood what you meant.
entries.question: 你被別人誤解過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been misunderstood?
entries.answer: 有，同事誤解過我說的話。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a coworker once misunderstood what I said.

entries.example: 古代打仗的時候，騎兵跑得最快。
entries.exampleEnglish: In ancient warfare, the cavalry was the fastest.
entries.question: 你在電影裡看過騎兵嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen cavalry in a movie?
entries.answer: 看過，古裝電影裡常常有很多騎兵。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, period films often have lots of cavalry.

entries.example: 今天天空很陰沉，好像快下雨了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The sky is gloomy today; it looks like it's about to rain.
entries.question: 天氣陰沉的時候，你心情好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you in a good mood when the weather is gloomy?
entries.answer: 不太好，天氣陰沉的時候我不想出門。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. When it's gloomy I don't feel like going out.

entries.example: 小鳥拍動翅膀，飛走了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The little bird flapped its wings and flew away.
entries.question: 你看過蝴蝶拍動翅膀嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever watched a butterfly flap its wings?
entries.answer: 看過，我在陽明山看過蝴蝶拍動翅膀。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've watched butterflies flapping their wings on Yangmingshan.

entries.example: 他用夾鉗把木板固定在桌上。
entries.exampleEnglish: He used a clamp to fix the board to the table.
entries.question: 你用過夾鉗這種工具嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever used a tool like a clamp?
entries.answer: 用過，我做木工的時候會用夾鉗。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use clamps when I do woodwork.

entries.example: 公司請了一位日文翻譯員。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company hired a Japanese translator.
entries.question: 你想當翻譯員嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a translator?
entries.answer: 想，我想當英文翻譯員。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to be an English translator.

entries.example: 他面試沒過，覺得很沮喪。
entries.exampleEnglish: He didn't pass the interview and felt very discouraged.
entries.question: 你覺得沮喪的時候會做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you feel down?
entries.answer: 我覺得沮喪的時候會去跑步。
entries.answerEnglish: When I feel down, I go for a run.

entries.example: 看到以前的老照片，我有點感傷。
entries.exampleEnglish: Seeing old photos makes me a bit sentimental.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你覺得感傷？
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you feel sentimental?
entries.answer: 離開家鄉的時候，我覺得很感傷。
entries.answerEnglish: I felt very sad when I left my hometown.

entries.example: 恆春半島在台灣的最南邊。
entries.exampleEnglish: The Hengchun Peninsula is at the southern tip of Taiwan.
entries.question: 你去過哪個半島玩？
entries.questionEnglish: Which peninsula have you visited?
entries.answer: 我去過恆春半島，那裡的海很漂亮。
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to the Hengchun Peninsula; the sea there is beautiful.

entries.example: 他們把門口那棵樹砍掉了。
entries.exampleEnglish: They cut down the tree by the front door.
entries.question: 露營的時候，你砍過木頭嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever chopped wood when camping?
entries.answer: 砍過，我們砍木頭來生火。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we chopped wood to make a fire.

entries.example: 大家都同意，沒有人有異議。
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone agreed; nobody had any objection.
entries.question: 開會時，你會提出異議嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you raise objections in meetings?
entries.answer: 會，如果我不同意，我會提出異議。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if I disagree, I raise an objection.

entries.example: 我想把頭髮染成咖啡色。
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to dye my hair brown.
entries.question: 你染過頭髮嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever dyed your hair?
entries.answer: 染過，我以前把頭髮染成金色。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used to dye my hair blond.

entries.example: 這件事老闆有最後的否決權。
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss has the final veto on this.
entries.question: 在你家，誰有否決權？
entries.questionEnglish: Who has the power of veto in your family?
entries.answer: 我太太有否決權，她說不行就不行。
entries.answerEnglish: My wife has the veto; if she says no, it's no.

entries.example: 工地有一台很高的起重機。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a very tall crane at the construction site.
entries.question: 你家附近有起重機在蓋大樓嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there cranes building something near your home?
entries.answer: 有，對面的工地有兩台起重機。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the construction site across the street has two cranes.

entries.example: 把西瓜對半切，一人一半。
entries.exampleEnglish: Cut the watermelon in half, one half each.
entries.question: 吃三明治的時候，你會對半切嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cut your sandwich in half?
entries.answer: 會，我喜歡把三明治對半切再吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like to cut my sandwich in half before eating it.

entries.example: 我好羨慕你可以去日本玩！
entries.exampleEnglish: I really envy you getting to go to Japan!
entries.question: 你最羨慕誰？
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you envy most?
entries.answer: 我最羨慕我哥哥，他每年都出國玩。
entries.answerEnglish: I envy my older brother most; he travels abroad every year.

entries.example: 農夫春天在田裡播種。
entries.exampleEnglish: Farmers sow seeds in the fields in spring.
entries.question: 你在陽台播種過什麼植物嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever sown any plants on your balcony?
entries.answer: 我播種過番茄，現在長得很高了。
entries.answerEnglish: I've sown tomatoes, and now they've grown really tall.

entries.example: 她今天擦了紅色的口紅。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's wearing red lipstick today.
entries.question: 你常擦口紅嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often wear lipstick?
entries.answer: 上班的時候我會擦口紅。
entries.answerEnglish: I wear lipstick when I go to work.

entries.example: 他對員工很無情。
entries.exampleEnglish: He is ruthless toward his employees.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼樣的老闆很無情？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of boss do you think is heartless?
entries.answer: 隨便開除員工的老闆很無情。
entries.answerEnglish: A boss who fires people on a whim is heartless.

entries.example: 這次颱風沒有造成太大的損傷。
entries.exampleEnglish: This typhoon didn't cause much damage.
entries.question: 你覺得常滑手機會損傷眼睛嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think using your phone a lot damages your eyes?
entries.answer: 會，一直看手機會損傷眼睛。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, looking at your phone all the time damages your eyes.

entries.example: 吃太飽了，我需要時間消化。
entries.exampleEnglish: I ate too much; I need time to digest.
entries.question: 你吃什麼東西不好消化？
entries.questionEnglish: What foods are hard for you to digest?
entries.answer: 我吃糯米做的東西不好消化。
entries.answerEnglish: Things made with sticky rice are hard for me to digest.

entries.example: 這座紀念館記錄了當年的屠殺。
entries.exampleEnglish: This memorial hall documents the massacre of that time.
entries.question: 在哪裡可以了解歷史上的屠殺？
entries.questionEnglish: Where can you learn about historical massacres?
entries.answer: 在紀念館可以了解歷史上的屠殺。
entries.answerEnglish: You can learn about historical massacres at memorial halls.

entries.example: 用槓桿投資，風險很大。
entries.exampleEnglish: Investing with leverage is very risky.
entries.question: 你會用槓桿投資嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you invest with leverage?
entries.answer: 不會，用槓桿投資太危險了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, investing with leverage is too dangerous.

entries.example: 大雨一直抽打著窗戶。
entries.exampleEnglish: The heavy rain kept lashing against the windows.
entries.question: 颱風天，你聽過雨抽打窗戶的聲音嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: On typhoon days, have you heard rain lashing the windows?
entries.answer: 聽過，雨一直抽打窗戶，很吵。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the rain kept lashing the windows; it was very loud.

entries.english: act for; acting (in a post); agent
entries.example: 店長請假，這週由我代理。
entries.exampleEnglish: The store manager is on leave, so I'm filling in this week.
entries.question: 你代理過別人的工作嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever covered someone else's job?
entries.answer: 代理過，同事休假時我代理他的工作。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I covered a coworker's job while he was on vacation.

entries.example: 搬家公司派了三個搬運工來。
entries.exampleEnglish: The moving company sent three movers.
entries.question: 你搬家時會請搬運工嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you hire movers when you move house?
entries.answer: 會，上次我請了兩個搬運工幫忙。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last time I hired two movers to help.

entries.example: 這部電影的女主角很會演戲。
entries.exampleEnglish: The lead actress in this movie is a great actor.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪部電影的女主角？
entries.questionEnglish: Which movie's heroine do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡《神隱少女》的女主角。
entries.answerEnglish: I like the heroine of Spirited Away best.

entries.example: 這部電影下週五首映。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie premieres next Friday.
entries.question: 你去過電影的首映會嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been to a movie premiere?
entries.answer: 去過，我去過一部台灣電影的首映會。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I went to the premiere of a Taiwanese film.

entries.example: 這件外套的襯裡破了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The lining of this jacket is torn.
entries.question: 你喜歡有襯裡的外套嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like jackets with a lining?
entries.answer: 喜歡，有襯裡的外套比較保暖。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, lined jackets are warmer.

entries.example: 這瓶清潔劑要加水稀釋再用。
entries.exampleEnglish: This cleaner has to be diluted with water before use.
entries.question: 你喝果汁會加水稀釋嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you dilute your juice with water?
entries.answer: 會，太甜的果汁我會加水稀釋。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if the juice is too sweet I add water to dilute it.

entries.example: 那個人是騙子，別相信他。
entries.exampleEnglish: That guy is a crook; don't trust him.
entries.question: 怎麼樣才不會被騙子騙？
entries.questionEnglish: How can you avoid being cheated by swindlers?
entries.answer: 不要相信陌生人的電話，那常常是騙子。
entries.answerEnglish: Don't trust calls from strangers; they're often swindlers.

entries.example: 外面突然下大雨了。
entries.exampleEnglish: It suddenly started pouring outside.
entries.question: 突然下雨時，你會怎麼辦？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when it suddenly rains?
entries.answer: 突然下雨的話，我會去便利商店買傘。
entries.answerEnglish: If it suddenly rains, I buy an umbrella at a convenience store.

entries.example: 新的證據推翻了原來的說法。
entries.exampleEnglish: New evidence overturned the original account.
entries.question: 你推翻過自己以前的想法嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever overturned your own earlier ideas?
entries.answer: 有，搬來台灣後，我推翻了很多以前的想法。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, after moving to Taiwan I overturned a lot of my old ideas.

entries.example: 那個推銷員一直糾纏我。
entries.exampleEnglish: That salesman kept pestering me.
entries.question: 被推銷員糾纏時，你會怎麼辦？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when a salesperson pesters you?
entries.answer: 我會說不用了，然後快點走，不讓他繼續糾纏。
entries.answerEnglish: I say no thanks and leave quickly so he can't keep pestering me.

entries.example: 公司要統一大家的報告格式。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company wants to standardize everyone's report format.
entries.question: 你覺得公司的制服應該統一嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think company uniforms should be standardized?
entries.answer: 應該，統一的制服看起來比較專業。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, matching uniforms look more professional.

entries.example: 鶯歌有很多賣陶瓷的店。
entries.exampleEnglish: Yingge has lots of shops selling ceramics.
entries.question: 你家有陶瓷做的碗嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have ceramic bowls at home?
entries.answer: 有，我在鶯歌買了幾個陶瓷碗。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bought a few ceramic bowls in Yingge.

entries.example: 這部電影的高潮在最後十分鐘。
entries.exampleEnglish: The climax of this movie is in the last ten minutes.
entries.question: 你看小說會先偷看高潮嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you peek at the climax when reading a novel?
entries.answer: 不會，我喜歡慢慢看到高潮。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I like to reach the climax slowly.

entries.example: 一艘大油輪停在高雄港。
entries.exampleEnglish: A big oil tanker is docked at Kaohsiung Harbor.
entries.question: 你在港口看過油輪嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen an oil tanker at a port?
entries.answer: 看過，我在高雄港看過很大的油輪。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a huge oil tanker at Kaohsiung Harbor.

entries.example: 我阿嬤年輕的時候很吃苦耐勞。
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma was very hardworking and tough when she was young.
entries.question: 你覺得自己吃苦耐勞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you can endure hardship and work hard?
entries.answer: 我覺得我滿吃苦耐勞的，加班也不抱怨。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm pretty tough; I don't complain even when working overtime.

entries.example: 這部電影講的是一場農民起義。
entries.exampleEnglish: This film is about a peasant uprising.
entries.question: 你知道哪一場有名的起義？
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous uprising do you know of?
entries.answer: 我知道武昌起義，那是辛亥革命的開始。
entries.answerEnglish: I know the Wuchang Uprising; it started the 1911 Revolution.

entries.example: 夜市的老闆大聲叫賣。
entries.exampleEnglish: The night market vendors loudly hawk their goods.
entries.question: 你在夜市聽過老闆叫賣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you heard vendors hawking at a night market?
entries.answer: 聽過，賣衣服的老闆叫賣得很大聲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the clothes sellers hawk really loudly.

entries.example: 這樣做太沒效率了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Doing it this way is too inefficient.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼事情很沒效率？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is really inefficient?
entries.answer: 我覺得開太多會很沒效率。
entries.answerEnglish: I think having too many meetings is very inefficient.

entries.example: 這個牌子的包包很耐用。
entries.exampleEnglish: This brand's bags are very durable.
entries.question: 你用過最耐用的東西是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the most durable thing you've ever owned?
entries.answer: 我的舊手機很耐用，用了六年。
entries.answerEnglish: My old phone was really durable; I used it for six years.

entries.example: 她戴了一頂金色的假髮。
entries.exampleEnglish: She wore a blond wig.
entries.question: 你戴過假髮嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever worn a wig?
entries.answer: 戴過，萬聖節的時候我戴過假髮。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wore a wig on Halloween.

entries.example: 週末的高速公路很塞。
entries.exampleEnglish: The freeway is jammed on weekends.
entries.question: 你常開高速公路嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often drive on the freeway?
entries.answer: 我回南部的時候會開高速公路。
entries.answerEnglish: I take the freeway when I go back down south.

entries.example: 醫生要遵守醫學倫理。
entries.exampleEnglish: Doctors must follow medical ethics.
entries.question: 你覺得工作上什麼倫理最重要？
entries.questionEnglish: Which work ethic do you think matters most?
entries.answer: 我覺得誠實是最重要的工作倫理。
entries.answerEnglish: I think honesty is the most important work ethic.

entries.example: 我想點一杯薄荷茶。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like to order a mint tea.
entries.question: 你喜歡薄荷口味嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like mint flavor?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常吃薄荷口香糖。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often chew mint gum.

entries.example: 出去露營帶一把萬用刀很方便。
entries.exampleEnglish: A multi-purpose knife is handy to bring when camping.
entries.question: 你家有什麼萬用的東西？
entries.questionEnglish: What all-purpose things do you have at home?
entries.answer: 我家的電鍋很萬用，什麼都能煮。
entries.answerEnglish: Our rice cooker is all-purpose; it can cook anything.

entries.example: 外面持續不斷地下雨。
entries.exampleEnglish: It keeps raining nonstop outside.
entries.question: 你家附近有持續不斷的噪音嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there constant noise near your home?
entries.answer: 有，隔壁工地每天持續不斷地施工。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the construction site next door works nonstop every day.

entries.example: 週末我們去鄰近的小鎮逛逛吧。
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's go explore a nearby town this weekend.
entries.question: 你去過台灣鄰近的哪些國家？
entries.questionEnglish: Which of Taiwan's neighboring countries have you been to?
entries.answer: 我去過日本和菲律賓，都是台灣鄰近的國家。
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Japan and the Philippines, both neighbors of Taiwan.

entries.example: 很多人抵制那家公司的產品。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many people are boycotting that company's products.
entries.question: 你抵制過什麼品牌嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever boycotted a brand?
entries.answer: 有，我抵制過不環保的品牌。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've boycotted brands that aren't eco-friendly.

entries.example: 現實有時候很殘酷。
entries.exampleEnglish: Reality is sometimes harsh.
entries.question: 你覺得職場很殘酷嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the workplace is brutal?
entries.answer: 有時候很殘酷，表現不好就會被換掉。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes it's brutal; if you don't perform well, you get replaced.

entries.example: 我對貓過敏，一直打噴嚏。

entries.answer: 很多人吃蝦子會過敏。
entries.answerEnglish: Many people are allergic to shrimp.

entries.example: 他當兵的時候是步兵。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was in the infantry when he did his military service.
entries.question: 你的朋友當兵時是什麼兵？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of soldier was your friend during military service?
entries.answer: 我朋友當兵的時候是步兵。
entries.answerEnglish: My friend was an infantryman during his service.

entries.example: 網路有點延遲，聲音跟不上。
entries.exampleEnglish: The internet is lagging a bit, and the sound can't keep up.
entries.question: 你玩線上遊戲會遇到延遲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get lag when playing online games?
entries.answer: 會，晚上網路常常延遲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the internet often lags at night.

entries.example: 他很喜歡看體育新聞。
entries.exampleEnglish: He loves watching sports news.
entries.question: 你喜歡看哪種體育節目？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of sports programs do you like to watch?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡看體育台的棒球比賽。
entries.answerEnglish: I like watching baseball games on the sports channel most.

entries.example: 我朋友在樂團裡吹小號。
entries.exampleEnglish: My friend plays trumpet in a band.
entries.question: 你聽過有人現場吹小號嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever heard someone play the trumpet live?
entries.answer: 聽過，我在爵士酒吧聽過有人吹小號。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I heard someone play the trumpet at a jazz bar.

entries.example: 廟裡的氣氛很莊嚴。
entries.exampleEnglish: The atmosphere in the temple is very solemn.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪個地方很莊嚴？
entries.questionEnglish: Which place in Taiwan do you find solemn?
entries.answer: 我覺得中正紀念堂很莊嚴。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall is very solemn.

entries.example: 這首歌的節奏很輕快。
entries.exampleEnglish: This song has a light, lively rhythm.
entries.question: 你喜歡聽輕快的音樂嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like listening to upbeat music?
entries.answer: 喜歡，早上我會聽輕快的音樂。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I listen to upbeat music in the morning.

entries.example: 每年都有很多朝聖者去麥加。
entries.exampleEnglish: Every year many pilgrims go to Mecca.
entries.question: 你想當朝聖者，走一次朝聖之路嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to walk a pilgrimage route as a pilgrim?
entries.answer: 想，我想當朝聖者，走一次西班牙的朝聖之路。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to walk the Camino in Spain as a pilgrim.

entries.example: 對我來說，珍奶是不可抗拒的誘惑。
entries.exampleEnglish: For me, bubble tea is an irresistible temptation.
entries.question: 什麼食物對你來說不可抗拒？
entries.questionEnglish: What food is irresistible to you?
entries.answer: 夜市的鹽酥雞對我來說不可抗拒。
entries.answerEnglish: Night market popcorn chicken is irresistible to me.

entries.example: 那匹母馬剛生了一匹小馬。
entries.exampleEnglish: That mare just gave birth to a foal.
entries.question: 你在農場看過母馬跟小馬嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a mare and a foal at a farm?
entries.answer: 看過，母馬一直待在小馬旁邊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the mare stayed right beside the foal the whole time.

entries.example: 列印之前，先預覽一下。
entries.exampleEnglish: Preview it before you print.
entries.question: 你寄重要的信前會先預覽嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you preview important emails before sending them?
entries.answer: 會，我寄信前都會先預覽一次。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always preview an email once before sending it.

entries.english: ponder; muse; be lost in thought
entries.example: 他坐在海邊沉思了很久。
entries.exampleEnglish: He sat by the sea, lost in thought for a long time.
entries.question: 你喜歡在哪裡沉思？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you like to sit and think?
entries.answer: 我喜歡一個人在咖啡廳裡沉思。
entries.answerEnglish: I like to sit alone in a café and think.

entries.exampleEnglish: The company slashed a lot of its budget this year.
entries.question: 你最近削減了哪些花費？
entries.questionEnglish: What spending have you cut recently?
entries.answer: 我削減了外食的花費，現在常常自己煮。
entries.answerEnglish: I cut back on eating out; now I often cook for myself.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'm really scared of injections.
entries.question: 你最害怕什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What are you most afraid of?
entries.answer: 我最害怕蟑螂。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most afraid of cockroaches.

entries.example: 這間醫院附屬於一所大學。
entries.exampleEnglish: This hospital is affiliated with a university.
entries.question: 你家附近有大學附屬醫院嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a university-affiliated hospital near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家附近有一間大學附屬醫院。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a university hospital near my home.

entries.example: 我很想去地中海旅行。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd really like to travel to the Mediterranean.
entries.question: 你吃過地中海料理嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had Mediterranean food?
entries.answer: 吃過，我很喜歡地中海料理。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love Mediterranean food.

entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone, please cooperate and line up.
entries.question: 你的工作需要跟很多人配合嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your job require coordinating with a lot of people?
entries.answer: 需要，我常常要配合其他部門。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often have to coordinate with other departments.

entries.example: 他們發表了一份環保宣言。
entries.exampleEnglish: They issued an environmental manifesto.
entries.question: 如果你寫人生宣言，第一句是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: If you wrote a life manifesto, what would the first line be?
entries.answer: 我的人生宣言第一句是：開心最重要。
entries.answerEnglish: The first line of my life manifesto is: being happy matters most.

entries.example: 公司想讓產品更多樣化。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company wants to diversify its products.
entries.question: 你的飲食多樣化嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your diet varied?
entries.answer: 還算多樣化，我每天吃不一樣的東西。
entries.answerEnglish: Fairly varied; I eat different things every day.

entries.example: 店家用買一送一引誘客人。
entries.exampleEnglish: Shops lure customers with buy-one-get-one-free deals.
entries.question: 什麼東西最能引誘你花錢？
entries.questionEnglish: What tempts you to spend money the most?
entries.answer: 打折最能引誘我花錢。
entries.answerEnglish: Sales tempt me to spend money the most.

entries.example: 夏天吃涼麵很清爽。
entries.exampleEnglish: Cold noodles are refreshing in summer.
entries.question: 夏天你喜歡吃什麼清爽的東西？
entries.questionEnglish: What refreshing food do you like in summer?
entries.answer: 我喜歡吃愛玉，很清爽。
entries.answerEnglish: I like aiyu jelly; it's very refreshing.

entries.example: 海關抓到有人走私香菸。
entries.exampleEnglish: Customs caught someone smuggling cigarettes.
entries.question: 海關怎麼防止走私？
entries.questionEnglish: How does customs prevent smuggling?
entries.answer: 海關會檢查行李，防止有人走私。
entries.answerEnglish: Customs checks luggage to stop people smuggling.

entries.example: 這位劇作家寫了很多舞台劇。
entries.exampleEnglish: This playwright has written many stage plays.
entries.question: 你知道哪一位有名的劇作家？
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous playwright do you know?
entries.answer: 我知道莎士比亞，他是很有名的劇作家。
entries.answerEnglish: I know Shakespeare; he's a very famous playwright.

entries.example: 咖啡的香氣好濃。
entries.exampleEnglish: The aroma of the coffee is so rich.
entries.question: 你最喜歡什麼香氣？
entries.questionEnglish: What scent do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡剛烤好的麵包的香氣。
entries.answerEnglish: I love the aroma of freshly baked bread most.

entries.example: 颱風來了，外面的風一直呼嘯。
entries.exampleEnglish: The typhoon has arrived, and the wind keeps howling outside.
entries.question: 颱風天，你聽過風呼嘯的聲音嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: On typhoon days, have you heard the wind howling?
entries.answer: 聽過，晚上風呼嘯得很可怕。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the wind howls really frighteningly at night.

entries.example: 中秋節我們在家烤肉。
entries.exampleEnglish: We have a barbecue at home for Moon Festival.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃烤玉米嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like grilled corn?
entries.answer: 喜歡，夜市的烤玉米很好吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the grilled corn at night markets is delicious.

entries.example: 他是我們公司的現任總經理。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's the current general manager of our company.
entries.question: 你跟現任主管相處得好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get along with your current supervisor?
entries.answer: 很好，我的現任主管很好溝通。
entries.answerEnglish: Very well; my current supervisor is easy to talk to.

entries.example: 我昨晚看了一本驚悚小說。
entries.exampleEnglish: I read a thriller last night.
entries.question: 你喜歡看驚悚小說嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like reading thrillers?
entries.answer: 喜歡，可是看完驚悚小說會睡不著。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but after reading a thriller I can't sleep.

entries.example: 銀行免除了這筆手續費。
entries.exampleEnglish: The bank waived this service fee.
entries.question: 你希望哪一種費用可以免除？
entries.questionEnglish: Which fee would you like to see waived?
entries.answer: 我希望跨行轉帳的手續費可以免除。
entries.answerEnglish: I wish fees for transfers between banks could be waived.

entries.example: 我坐太久，站起來有點頭暈。
entries.exampleEnglish: I sat too long and felt a bit dizzy when I stood up.
entries.question: 你坐船會頭暈嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get dizzy on boats?
entries.answer: 會，我坐船一定會頭暈。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always get dizzy on boats.

entries.example: 她在大學研究遺傳學。
entries.exampleEnglish: She does research in genetics at a university.
entries.question: 你對遺傳學有興趣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in genetics?
entries.answer: 有一點，我覺得遺傳學很有趣。
entries.answerEnglish: A little; I find genetics really interesting.

entries.example: 他直截了當地拒絕了我。
entries.exampleEnglish: He turned me down flatly.
entries.question: 你喜歡別人說話直截了當嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like people to speak straightforwardly?
entries.answer: 喜歡，直截了當比較不會誤會。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, being direct leads to fewer misunderstandings.

entries.example: 去墾丁玩了三天，我曬黑了。
entries.exampleEnglish: After three days in Kenting, I got a tan.
entries.question: 你怕曬黑嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you worried about getting tanned?
entries.answer: 不怕，我覺得曬黑看起來很健康。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I think a tan looks healthy.

entries.example: 過年的年夜飯很豐盛。
entries.exampleEnglish: The Lunar New Year's Eve dinner is a lavish feast.
entries.question: 你吃過最豐盛的一餐是什麼？

entries.answer: 朋友的喜酒是我吃過最豐盛的一餐。
entries.answerEnglish: My friend's wedding banquet was the most lavish meal I've had.

entries.example: 我每天早上喝一杯濃縮咖啡。
entries.exampleEnglish: I drink an espresso every morning.
entries.question: 你喝過濃縮咖啡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had espresso?
entries.answer: 喝過，濃縮咖啡太苦了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, espresso is too bitter.

entries.exampleEnglish: This report exposed a lot of problems.
entries.question: 你看過揭露社會問題的紀錄片嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you watched documentaries that expose social problems?
entries.answer: 看過，我看過一部揭露食安問題的紀錄片。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I watched a documentary exposing food safety problems.

entries.exampleEnglish: Grate the cheese and put it on the pizza.

entries.answerEnglish: I grate garlic and add it to sauces.

entries.example: 天上的烏雲預示著快要下雨了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The dark clouds in the sky signal that it's about to rain.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼現象預示颱風要來了？
entries.questionEnglish: What signs do you think herald an approaching typhoon?
entries.answer: 天空變成橘紅色，常常預示颱風要來了。
entries.answerEnglish: When the sky turns orange-red, it often means a typhoon is coming.

entries.example: 我家附近有很多流浪貓。

entries.question: 你餵過流浪貓嗎？

entries.answer: 餵過，我常常餵公司樓下的流浪貓。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often feed the stray cats downstairs from my office.

entries.example: 他們昨天又吵架了。
entries.exampleEnglish: They had another argument yesterday.
entries.question: 你常跟家人吵架嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often argue with your family?
entries.answer: 不常，我們很少吵架。
entries.answerEnglish: Not often; we rarely argue.

entries.example: 醫院的飯菜淡而無味。
entries.exampleEnglish: Hospital food is bland and tasteless.
entries.question: 你覺得哪種食物淡而無味？
entries.questionEnglish: Which food do you find bland?
entries.answer: 我覺得白稀飯淡而無味。
entries.answerEnglish: I find plain rice porridge bland.

entries.exampleEnglish: My scooter got towed!
entries.question: 你的車被拖吊過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your vehicle ever been towed?
entries.answer: 被拖吊過，因為我停在紅線上。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, because I parked on a red line.

entries.example: 戰爭中的暴行被寫進了歷史。
entries.exampleEnglish: The atrocities of the war were written into history.

entries.questionEnglish: Where can you see records of wartime atrocities?
entries.answer: 博物館裡有很多戰爭暴行的紀錄。
entries.answerEnglish: Museums have many records of wartime atrocities.

entries.example: 復活節的時候，小孩會找彩蛋。
entries.exampleEnglish: At Easter, kids hunt for painted eggs.
entries.question: 你的國家怎麼過復活節？
entries.questionEnglish: How is Easter celebrated in your country?
entries.answer: 我們復活節會吃巧克力蛋。
entries.answerEnglish: We eat chocolate eggs at Easter.

entries.example: 麻煩幫我把這個消息傳遞給大家。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please pass this news on to everyone for me.
entries.question: 你們公司用什麼傳遞訊息？
entries.questionEnglish: What does your company use to pass on messages?
entries.answer: 我們公司用LINE傳遞訊息。
entries.answerEnglish: Our company uses LINE to pass on messages.

entries.example: 他是一位受人尊敬的政治家。
entries.exampleEnglish: He is a respected statesman.
entries.question: 你覺得好的政治家需要什麼特質？
entries.questionEnglish: What qualities do you think a good statesman needs?
entries.answer: 好的政治家要誠實，也要有遠見。
entries.answerEnglish: A good statesman must be honest and have vision.

entries.example: 泡溫泉可以舒緩壓力。
entries.exampleEnglish: Soaking in a hot spring can relieve stress.
entries.question: 你用什麼方法舒緩壓力？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you relieve stress?
entries.answer: 我用運動來舒緩壓力。
entries.answerEnglish: I relieve stress by exercising.

entries.example: 這家餐廳只賣素食。
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant only serves vegetarian food.
entries.question: 你吃過台灣的素食自助餐嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you tried a Taiwanese vegetarian buffet?
entries.answer: 吃過，台灣的素食自助餐很好吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Taiwanese vegetarian buffets are delicious.

entries.exampleEnglish: That celebrity has two bodyguards with him.
entries.question: 你覺得明星需要保鑣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think celebrities need bodyguards?
entries.answer: 需要，粉絲太多的話就需要保鑣。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if they have too many fans they need bodyguards.

entries.example: 薪水要先扣除勞健保。
entries.exampleEnglish: Labor and health insurance are deducted from your salary first.
entries.question: 你的薪水每個月會扣除什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's deducted from your salary each month?
entries.answer: 我的薪水會扣除勞保和健保。
entries.answerEnglish: Labor insurance and health insurance are deducted from my pay.

entries.example: 他的勇氣令人欽佩。
entries.exampleEnglish: His courage is admirable.
entries.question: 你覺得誰的故事令人欽佩？

entries.answer: 我阿公白手起家，他的故事令人欽佩。
entries.answerEnglish: My grandpa built everything from nothing; his story is admirable.

entries.example: 今晚有一場弦樂四重奏的表演。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a string quartet performance tonight.
entries.question: 你聽過弦樂四重奏嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever heard a string quartet?
entries.answer: 聽過，我在國家音樂廳聽過弦樂四重奏。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I heard a string quartet at the National Concert Hall.

entries.example: 我只是個凡人，也會犯錯。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm only human; I make mistakes too.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是凡人還是超人？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're an ordinary mortal or a superhero?
entries.answer: 我是凡人，每天都要睡八個小時。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a mere mortal; I need eight hours of sleep every day.

entries.example: 德國是一個高度工業化的國家。
entries.exampleEnglish: Germany is a highly industrialized country.
entries.question: 你的國家很早就工業化了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did your country industrialize early?
entries.answer: 是，我的國家很早就工業化了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country industrialized very early.

entries.example: 青菜放太久，變得軟趴趴的。
entries.exampleEnglish: The greens were left too long and went limp.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃軟趴趴的薯條嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like soggy fries?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，軟趴趴的薯條不好吃。
entries.answerEnglish: No, soggy fries don't taste good.

entries.english: get tangled; knot; tie a knot

entries.exampleEnglish: My earphone cord got tangled again.
entries.question: 你的頭髮常常打結嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your hair often get tangled?
entries.answer: 會，我的長頭髮很容易打結。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my long hair tangles easily.

entries.question: 發現腫瘤的時候應該怎麼辦？

entries.answerEnglish: If a tumor is found, it should be checked at a major hospital as soon as possible.

entries.question: 你的會員等級被降級過嗎？

entries.answer: 有，我很少搭飛機，會員就被降級了。

entries.exampleEnglish: The pastor of this church is very kind.

entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my friend's father is a pastor.

entries.exampleEnglish: The government plans to tax sugary drinks.
entries.question: 你覺得應該對含糖飲料徵稅嗎？

entries.answer: 應該，徵稅可以讓大家少喝一點。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a tax would make people drink less of them.

entries.example: 一輛跑車從我旁邊疾駛而過。
entries.exampleEnglish: A sports car sped past me.

entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen scooters speeding past on the road?
entries.answer: 常常看到，很多機車在路上疾駛而過。
entries.answerEnglish: All the time; lots of scooters speed past on the roads.

entries.answer: 會，路很滑的時候我會騎很慢。

entries.example: 這間音樂廳的聲學設計很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: This concert hall has excellent acoustic design.
entries.question: 你覺得哪裡的聲學效果最好？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think the acoustics are best?
entries.answer: 我覺得國家音樂廳的聲學效果最好。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the National Concert Hall has the best acoustics.

entries.english: salvage; recover from water; dredge up
entries.example: 他們從海裡打撈起一艘舊船。
entries.exampleEnglish: They salvaged an old boat from the sea.
entries.question: 東西掉進水裡，你會想辦法打撈嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: If something falls into the water, do you try to fish it out?
entries.answer: 會，上次手機掉進池塘，我馬上把它打撈上來。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last time my phone fell in a pond, I fished it out right away.

entries.example: 夜空中的星星一直閃爍。
entries.exampleEnglish: The stars keep twinkling in the night sky.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過滿天星星閃爍？
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen a sky full of twinkling stars?
entries.answer: 我在合歡山看過滿天星星閃爍。
entries.answerEnglish: I saw a sky full of twinkling stars on Hehuan Mountain.

entries.example: 這是一部很感人的史詩電影。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a very moving epic film.
entries.question: 你看過哪部史詩電影？
entries.questionEnglish: Which epic films have you seen?
entries.answer: 我看過《魔戒》，那是我最喜歡的史詩電影。
entries.answerEnglish: I've seen The Lord of the Rings; it's my favorite epic film.

entries.example: 他故意說話挑釁別人。
entries.exampleEnglish: He deliberately says things to provoke people.
entries.question: 有人挑釁你的時候，你會怎麼做？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when someone provokes you?
entries.answer: 我不會理他，挑釁的人最怕被忽略。
entries.answerEnglish: I ignore them; people who provoke hate being ignored.

entries.example: 天快亮了，窗外有一點微光。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's almost dawn; there's a faint glimmer outside the window.
entries.question: 你睡覺時喜歡房間有一點微光嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like a little light in the room when you sleep?
entries.answer: 喜歡，有一點微光我比較好睡。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I sleep better with a little light.

entries.example: 他做事太魯莽了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He does things too rashly.
entries.question: 你做過什麼魯莽的決定？
entries.questionEnglish: What rash decision have you made?
entries.answer: 我曾經很魯莽地辭職去旅行。
entries.answerEnglish: I once rashly quit my job to go traveling.

entries.example: 他在網路上誹謗別人，結果被告了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He defamed someone online and ended up being sued.
entries.question: 在網路上誹謗別人會怎麼樣？
entries.questionEnglish: What happens if someone defames others online?
entries.answer: 在網路上誹謗別人可能會被告。
entries.answerEnglish: Defaming people online can get you sued.

entries.example: 這個週末有一場罷免投票。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a recall vote this weekend.
entries.question: 你知道台灣的罷免投票嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know about recall votes in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 知道，台灣人可以投票罷免立委。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, people in Taiwan can vote to recall legislators.

entries.english: a trace of; a shred of
entries.example: 他臉上沒有一絲笑容。
entries.exampleEnglish: There wasn't a trace of a smile on his face.
entries.question: 下班後，你還有一絲力氣運動嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: After work, do you have any energy left to exercise?
entries.answer: 沒有，下班後我連一絲力氣都沒有。
entries.answerEnglish: No, after work I don't have a shred of energy left.

entries.example: 最後一百公尺他開始衝刺。
entries.exampleEnglish: He started sprinting in the last hundred meters.
entries.question: 工作截止前，你會最後衝刺嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you make a final push before a work deadline?
entries.answer: 會，我常常在截止前一天衝刺。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often make a final push the day before the deadline.

entries.example: 士兵向國旗敬禮。
entries.exampleEnglish: The soldiers saluted the flag.
entries.question: 在你的國家，什麼人需要敬禮？
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, who has to salute?
entries.answer: 在我的國家，軍人和警察需要敬禮。
entries.answerEnglish: In my country, soldiers and police officers have to salute.

entries.example: 我的主管很嚴厲。
entries.exampleEnglish: My supervisor is very strict.
entries.question: 你小時候，爸媽很嚴厲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Were your parents strict when you were young?
entries.answer: 我爸爸很嚴厲，我媽媽比較溫柔。
entries.answerEnglish: My dad was very strict; my mom was gentler.

entries.example: 環境會塑造一個人的個性。
entries.exampleEnglish: Environment shapes a person's character.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼塑造了你的個性？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think shaped your personality?
entries.answer: 我覺得旅行塑造了我的個性。
entries.answerEnglish: I think traveling shaped my personality.

entries.example: 我用圖釘把海報釘在牆上。
entries.exampleEnglish: I pinned the poster to the wall with thumbtacks.
entries.question: 你的辦公室會用圖釘嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use thumbtacks at your office?
entries.answer: 會，我用圖釘把行事曆釘在牆上。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use thumbtacks to pin my calendar to the wall.

entries.example: 他很機智地回答了客人的問題。
entries.exampleEnglish: He answered the customer's question very cleverly.
entries.question: 你身邊有誰很機智？
entries.questionEnglish: Who around you is quick-witted?
entries.answer: 我同事很機智，什麼問題都難不倒他。
entries.answerEnglish: My coworker is quick-witted; no question can stump him.

entries.example: 在麵包上抹一點奶油。
entries.exampleEnglish: Spread a little butter on the bread.
entries.question: 你吃吐司喜歡抹什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like to spread on your toast?
entries.answer: 我喜歡在吐司上抹花生醬。
entries.answerEnglish: I like spreading peanut butter on my toast.

entries.example: 爬完玉山，大家都精疲力盡。
entries.exampleEnglish: After climbing Jade Mountain, everyone was exhausted.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你精疲力盡？
entries.questionEnglish: What leaves you completely exhausted?
entries.answer: 連續加班一個禮拜會讓我精疲力盡。
entries.answerEnglish: Working overtime for a whole week leaves me exhausted.

entries.example: 他很自負，覺得自己最厲害。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very conceited and thinks he's the best.
entries.question: 你遇過很自負的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever met a really conceited person?
entries.answer: 遇過，我以前有一個同事很自負。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used to have a really conceited coworker.

entries.example: 美國總統甘迺迪在1963年被暗殺。
entries.exampleEnglish: US President Kennedy was assassinated in 1963.
entries.question: 歷史上有哪些有名的暗殺事件？
entries.questionEnglish: What are some famous assassinations in history?
entries.answer: 甘迺迪總統被暗殺是很有名的事件。
entries.answerEnglish: The assassination of President Kennedy is a famous one.

entries.example: 我們跋涉了三天才到山屋。
entries.exampleEnglish: We trekked for three days before reaching the mountain hut.
entries.question: 你曾經長途跋涉去旅行嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever made a long trek on a trip?
entries.answer: 有，我長途跋涉去爬過玉山。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I made the long trek to climb Jade Mountain.

entries.example: 兩國同意休戰一個月。
entries.exampleEnglish: The two countries agreed to a one-month truce.
entries.question: 跟家人吵架後，誰會先提議休戰？
entries.questionEnglish: After a family argument, who suggests a truce first?
entries.answer: 通常是我先提議休戰，請大家吃東西。
entries.answerEnglish: Usually I suggest a truce first and treat everyone to food.

entries.example: 戰爭結束後，俘虜都被放回去了。
entries.exampleEnglish: After the war ended, the captives were all released.
entries.question: 戰爭結束後，俘虜通常會怎麼樣？
entries.questionEnglish: What usually happens to prisoners of war after a war ends?
entries.answer: 戰爭結束後，俘虜通常會被送回國。
entries.answerEnglish: After a war, prisoners of war are usually sent home.

entries.example: 這個計畫已經陷入泥沼了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This project has got bogged down.
entries.question: 你的工作有陷入泥沼的時候嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your work ever get bogged down?
entries.answer: 有，案子一直卡住，就像陷入泥沼。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when a case keeps stalling, it's like being stuck in a bog.

entries.english: brew; be in the making; plan
entries.example: 公司正在醞釀一個新計畫。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company is brewing a new plan.
entries.question: 你心裡在醞釀什麼新計畫嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you mulling over any new plans?
entries.answer: 我在醞釀明年去日本打工度假的計畫。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm working on a plan to do a working holiday in Japan next year.

entries.example: 他是一位很有名的異議人士。
entries.exampleEnglish: He is a well-known dissident.
entries.question: 你知道哪些有名的異議人士？
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous dissidents do you know of?
entries.answer: 我知道劉曉波，他是有名的異議人士。
entries.answerEnglish: I know of Liu Xiaobo; he was a famous dissident.

entries.example: 總統派了一位特使去美國。
entries.exampleEnglish: The president sent an envoy to the US.
entries.question: 你覺得當特使需要什麼能力？
entries.questionEnglish: What skills do you think an envoy needs?
entries.answer: 當特使要很會說話，也要懂外語。
entries.answerEnglish: An envoy has to be a good speaker and know foreign languages.

entries.example: 這種維他命有添加鋅。
entries.exampleEnglish: This vitamin has added zinc.
entries.question: 你知道哪些食物有鋅嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which foods contain zinc?
entries.answer: 我知道蚵仔有很多鋅。
entries.answerEnglish: I know oysters have a lot of zinc.

entries.example: 這個便當盒是鋁做的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This lunch box is made of aluminum.
entries.question: 你家有鋁做的鍋子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have aluminum pots at home?
entries.answer: 有，我家有一個鋁鍋。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we have an aluminum pot.

entries.example: 我很尊敬我的老闆。
entries.exampleEnglish: I really respect my boss.
entries.question: 你最尊敬哪個人？
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you respect most?
entries.answer: 我最尊敬我媽媽。
entries.answerEnglish: I respect my mom most.

entries.example: 今年冬天這麼熱，天氣真反常。
entries.exampleEnglish: This winter is so hot; the weather is really abnormal.
entries.question: 你覺得最近的天氣反常嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the weather has been unusual lately?
entries.answer: 很反常，十一月了還這麼熱。
entries.answerEnglish: Very unusual; it's November and still so hot.

entries.example: 他馬上反駁我的說法。
entries.exampleEnglish: He immediately refuted what I said.
entries.question: 開會時，你會反駁主管嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you contradict your supervisor in meetings?
entries.answer: 有時候會，可是我會很有禮貌地反駁。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes, but I push back very politely.

entries.example: 我們公司每季開一次大會。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company holds a big meeting every quarter.
entries.question: 你每季都會買新衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you buy new clothes every season?
entries.answer: 不會，我沒有每季都買新衣服。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't buy new clothes every season.

entries.example: 杯子掉到地上碎裂了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The cup fell to the floor and shattered.
entries.question: 你的手機螢幕碎裂過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your phone screen ever cracked?
entries.answer: 有，我的手機螢幕碎裂過兩次。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my phone screen has cracked twice.

entries.example: 這台機器還能正常運作。
entries.exampleEnglish: This machine still works normally.
entries.question: 你家最舊的電器還能運作嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does the oldest appliance in your home still work?
entries.answer: 可以，我家的舊電扇還能運作。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our old electric fan still works.

entries.example: 我在陽台放了一個小鳥餵食器。
entries.exampleEnglish: I put a bird feeder on the balcony.
entries.question: 你家有寵物餵食器嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a pet feeder at home?
entries.answer: 有，出門時我用餵食器餵貓。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use a feeder to feed my cat when I'm out.

entries.example: 他因為一直遲到，被逐出了樂團。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was kicked out of the band for always being late.
entries.question: 什麼樣的人會被逐出群組？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of people get kicked out of a group chat?
entries.answer: 一直傳廣告的人會被逐出群組。
entries.answerEnglish: People who keep posting ads get kicked out of the group.

entries.example: 手機的電快耗盡了。
entries.exampleEnglish: My phone battery is almost dead.
entries.question: 你的手機電量常常耗盡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your phone battery often run out?
entries.answer: 常常，出門玩一天手機電就耗盡了。
entries.answerEnglish: Often; after a day out, my phone battery is drained.

entries.example: 法律禁止賄賂公務員。
entries.exampleEnglish: The law forbids bribing civil servants.
entries.question: 為什麼法律禁止賄賂？
entries.questionEnglish: Why does the law forbid bribery?
entries.answer: 因為賄賂會讓社會不公平。
entries.answerEnglish: Because bribery makes society unfair.

entries.example: 政府發放了消費券給大家。
entries.exampleEnglish: The government gave out shopping vouchers to everyone.
entries.question: 你們公司會發放年終獎金嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company give out year-end bonuses?
entries.answer: 會，我們公司過年前會發放年終獎金。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our company gives out year-end bonuses before Lunar New Year.

entries.example: 飯店每天都會清潔房間。
entries.exampleEnglish: The hotel cleans the rooms every day.
entries.question: 你多久清潔一次冷氣？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you clean your air conditioner?
entries.answer: 我每年夏天前清潔一次冷氣。
entries.answerEnglish: I clean the air conditioner once every year before summer.

entries.example: 這家店七天內可以無條件退貨。
entries.exampleEnglish: This store accepts returns within seven days, no questions asked.
entries.question: 你喜歡可以無條件退貨的店嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like stores that take returns unconditionally?
entries.answer: 喜歡，可以無條件退貨比較放心。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, unconditional returns give me peace of mind.

entries.example: 颱風來了，這條路被封鎖了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The typhoon came and this road was closed off.
entries.question: 你在LINE上封鎖過別人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever blocked someone on LINE?
entries.answer: 有，我封鎖過一直傳廣告的人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've blocked people who kept sending ads.

entries.example: 他是一個真正的愛國者。
entries.exampleEnglish: He is a true patriot.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼樣的人算是愛國者？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of person do you think counts as a patriot?
entries.answer: 我覺得認真工作、遵守法律的人就是愛國者。
entries.answerEnglish: I think people who work hard and obey the law are patriots.

entries.example: 他說話很快。
entries.exampleEnglish: He talks very fast.
entries.question: 你喜歡跟誰說話？
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you like talking to?
entries.answer: 我喜歡跟我媽媽說話。
entries.answerEnglish: I like talking to my mom.

entries.example: 印度以前有種姓制度。
entries.exampleEnglish: India used to have a caste system.
entries.question: 你知道哪個國家有種姓制度？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which country has a caste system?
entries.answer: 我知道印度有種姓制度。
entries.answerEnglish: I know India has a caste system.

entries.example: 保護孩子是父母的本能。
entries.exampleEnglish: Protecting their children is a parent's instinct.
entries.question: 你覺得哪些事是人的本能？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think are human instincts?
entries.answer: 我覺得肚子餓想吃東西是本能。
entries.answerEnglish: I think wanting to eat when you're hungry is an instinct.

entries.example: 他喝醉了，一直胡言亂語。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was drunk and kept talking nonsense.
entries.question: 你太累的時候會胡言亂語嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you talk nonsense when you're too tired?
entries.answer: 會，我太累的時候常常胡言亂語。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often babble nonsense when I'm too tired.

entries.example: 報紙上登了他的訃聞。
entries.exampleEnglish: His obituary was published in the newspaper.
entries.question: 在台灣，訃聞上通常寫什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: In Taiwan, what is usually written in an obituary notice?
entries.answer: 訃聞通常寫告別式的時間和地點。
entries.answerEnglish: An obituary notice usually gives the time and place of the funeral.

entries.example: 他開一輛紅色的敞篷車。
entries.exampleEnglish: He drives a red convertible.
entries.question: 你想開敞篷車去兜風嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to go for a drive in a convertible?
entries.answer: 想，我想開敞篷車沿著海邊兜風。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd love to drive a convertible along the coast.

entries.example: 這個節日源自古代的異教習俗。
entries.exampleEnglish: This holiday comes from ancient pagan customs.
entries.question: 你知道哪些節日跟異教有關？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which holidays have pagan roots?
entries.answer: 聽說萬聖節跟古代異教的節日有關。
entries.answerEnglish: I've heard Halloween is linked to an ancient pagan festival.

entries.example: 她的鑽戒在燈下閃耀。
entries.exampleEnglish: Her diamond ring glitters under the light.
entries.question: 你覺得台北哪裡的夜景最閃耀？
entries.questionEnglish: Where in Taipei do you think the night view sparkles most?
entries.answer: 我覺得從象山看到的夜景最閃耀。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the night view from Elephant Mountain sparkles most.

entries.example: 商品有問題，我申請了退款。
entries.exampleEnglish: The item was faulty, so I requested a refund.
entries.question: 你網購的時候申請過退款嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever requested a refund when shopping online?
entries.answer: 申請過，賣家三天就退款給我了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the seller refunded me within three days.

entries.example: 那個城市晚上十點以後宵禁。
entries.exampleEnglish: That city has a curfew after 10 p.m.
entries.question: 你小時候家裡有宵禁嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you have a curfew at home growing up?
entries.answer: 有，我家的宵禁是晚上十點。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my curfew at home was 10 p.m.

entries.example: 他簽證過期，被驅逐出境了。
entries.exampleEnglish: His visa expired and he was deported.
entries.question: 什麼情況下外國人會被驅逐出境？
entries.questionEnglish: In what situations are foreigners deported?
entries.answer: 簽證過期太久的外國人可能會被驅逐出境。
entries.answerEnglish: Foreigners who overstay their visas too long may be deported.

entries.example: 這首歌的歌詞很感人。
entries.exampleEnglish: The lyrics of this song are very moving.
entries.question: 你記得哪首中文歌的歌詞？
entries.questionEnglish: Which Chinese song's lyrics do you remember?
entries.answer: 我記得《小幸運》的歌詞。
entries.answerEnglish: I remember the lyrics to "A Little Happiness."

entries.example: 博物館裡有一套古代的盔甲。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an ancient suit of armor in the museum.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過真的盔甲？
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen real armor?
entries.answer: 我在日本的城堡看過武士的盔甲。
entries.answerEnglish: I saw samurai armor at a castle in Japan.

entries.example: 記者在門口埋伏，想拍到明星。
entries.exampleEnglish: Reporters lay in wait at the door, hoping to photograph the star.
entries.question: 你覺得記者在明星家門口埋伏好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think it's okay for reporters to lie in wait outside celebrities' homes?
entries.answer: 不好，記者這樣埋伏會打擾別人的生活。
entries.answerEnglish: No, reporters lying in wait like that disturbs people's lives.

entries.example: 他大學畢業後專攻精神醫學。
entries.exampleEnglish: After graduating, he specialized in psychiatry.
entries.question: 精神醫學能幫助哪些人？
entries.questionEnglish: Who can psychiatry help?
entries.answer: 精神醫學能幫助有心理困擾的人。
entries.answerEnglish: Psychiatry can help people with mental health difficulties.

entries.example: 現在很流行喝手搖飲。
entries.exampleEnglish: Hand-shaken drinks are really popular right now.
entries.question: 你的國家現在流行什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's popular in your country right now?
entries.answer: 我的國家現在流行吃韓國菜。
entries.answerEnglish: Korean food is popular in my country right now.

entries.example: 牙痛折磨了我一整晚。
entries.exampleEnglish: My toothache tormented me all night.
entries.question: 什麼事最折磨你？
entries.questionEnglish: What torments you the most?
entries.answer: 每天塞車上班最折磨我。
entries.answerEnglish: Sitting in traffic on the way to work every day is torture for me.

entries.example: 以前的農夫用牛犁田。
entries.exampleEnglish: Farmers used to plow fields with oxen.
entries.question: 你看過有人用牛犁田嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen someone plow a field with an ox?
entries.answer: 看過，我在鄉下看過老伯伯用牛犁田。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw an old man plowing with an ox in the countryside.

entries.example: 他匆忙地跑去趕捷運。
entries.exampleEnglish: He rushed off to catch the MRT.
entries.question: 你早上出門會很匆忙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you in a rush when you leave home in the morning?
entries.answer: 會，我早上出門常常很匆忙。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm often in a rush when I leave in the morning.

entries.example: 那間珠寶店昨晚被洗劫了。
entries.exampleEnglish: That jewelry store was looted last night.
entries.question: 發生災難後，政府怎麼防止商店被洗劫？
entries.questionEnglish: After a disaster, how does the government stop stores from being looted?
entries.answer: 政府會派警察保護商店，防止被洗劫。
entries.answerEnglish: The government sends police to protect stores from looting.

entries.example: 我奶奶很節儉，從來不浪費。
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma is very thrifty and never wastes anything.
entries.question: 你是節儉的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you a thrifty person?
entries.answer: 我滿節儉的，很少買不需要的東西。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm pretty thrifty; I rarely buy things I don't need.

entries.example: 表演結束，觀眾大聲喝彩。
entries.exampleEnglish: When the show ended, the audience cheered loudly.
entries.question: 看球賽時，你會大聲喝彩嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cheer loudly at ball games?
entries.answer: 會，我看棒球的時候會大聲喝彩。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I cheer loudly when I watch baseball.

entries.example: 開會時請把手機調成靜音。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please set your phone to silent during the meeting.
entries.question: 你的手機常常開靜音嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your phone often on silent?
entries.answer: 常常，上班的時候我都開靜音。
entries.answerEnglish: Often; I keep it on silent at work.

entries.example: 他的腳傷已經康復了。
entries.exampleEnglish: His foot injury has healed.
entries.question: 生病後怎麼樣可以比較快康復？
entries.questionEnglish: How can someone recover faster after being ill?
entries.answer: 多休息、多喝水，可以比較快康復。
entries.answerEnglish: Resting and drinking plenty of water helps you recover faster.

entries.example: 快遞員把包裹送到公司了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The courier delivered the package to the office.
entries.question: 你常常收到快遞員送的包裹嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often get packages from couriers?
entries.answer: 常常，快遞員幾乎每天都來我們公司。
entries.answerEnglish: Often; couriers come to our office almost every day.

entries.example: 我要一杯珍珠奶茶。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like a bubble milk tea.
entries.question: 你喝奶茶喜歡加珍珠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like tapioca pearls in your milk tea?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我都會加很多珍珠。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always add lots of pearls.

entries.example: 這家咖啡廳很小，可是很溫馨。
entries.exampleEnglish: This café is small but very cozy.
entries.question: 你覺得你家溫馨嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your home is cozy?
entries.answer: 很溫馨，我家有很多植物跟暖暖的燈光。
entries.answerEnglish: Very cozy; my home has lots of plants and warm lighting.

entries.example: 他被老闆罵，就故意遲到來報復。
entries.exampleEnglish: After his boss scolded him, he came in late on purpose to get back at him.
entries.question: 被別人欺負時，報復是好方法嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When someone treats you badly, is revenge a good idea?
entries.answer: 不是，報復只會讓事情更糟。
entries.answerEnglish: No, revenge only makes things worse.

entries.example: 我老闆喜怒無常，很難相處。
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss is moody and hard to get along with.
entries.question: 你遇過喜怒無常的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever met a moody person?
entries.answer: 遇過，我以前的室友喜怒無常。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my former roommate was very moody.

entries.example: 他成功以後變得很自滿。
entries.exampleEnglish: He became complacent after his success.
entries.question: 你覺得成功的人容易自滿嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think successful people easily become complacent?
entries.answer: 我覺得有些人成功後很容易自滿。
entries.answerEnglish: I think some people easily become complacent after succeeding.

entries.example: 我家還有很多舊的錄影帶。
entries.exampleEnglish: We still have lots of old videotapes at home.
entries.question: 你小時候看過錄影帶嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you watch videotapes as a kid?
entries.answer: 看過，我小時候常租錄影帶回家看。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, as a kid I often rented videotapes to watch at home.

entries.example: 這個消息很快就在網路上擴散了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The news quickly spread online.
entries.question: 你覺得假新聞為什麼擴散得這麼快？
entries.questionEnglish: Why do you think fake news spreads so fast?
entries.answer: 因為大家看到就分享，所以假新聞擴散得很快。
entries.answerEnglish: Because people share whatever they see, fake news spreads fast.

entries.example: 週末公園有一場嘉年華。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a carnival in the park this weekend.
entries.question: 你參加過嘉年華嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been to a carnival?
entries.answer: 參加過，我參加過巴西的嘉年華。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to the carnival in Brazil.

entries.example: 池塘裡有很多鯉魚。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of carp in the pond.
entries.question: 你餵過鯉魚嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever fed carp?
entries.answer: 餵過，我在公園的池塘餵過鯉魚。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've fed the carp in a park pond.

entries.example: 我每天早上冥想十分鐘。
entries.exampleEnglish: I meditate for ten minutes every morning.
entries.question: 你試過冥想嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever tried meditating?
entries.answer: 試過，冥想讓我比較放鬆。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, meditation helps me relax.

entries.example: 地震的時候，他很鎮定。
entries.exampleEnglish: He stayed calm during the earthquake.
entries.question: 遇到地震時，你能保持鎮定嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you stay calm during an earthquake?
entries.answer: 可以，我在台灣住久了，地震時很鎮定。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've lived in Taiwan long enough to stay calm in earthquakes.

entries.example: 明星一出來就被粉絲包圍了。
entries.exampleEnglish: As soon as the star came out, fans surrounded him.
entries.question: 你家被什麼包圍？
entries.questionEnglish: What surrounds your home?
entries.answer: 我家四周被高樓大廈包圍。
entries.answerEnglish: My home is surrounded by tall buildings.

entries.example: 鶯歌住了很多陶藝家。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many potters live in Yingge.
entries.question: 你想跟陶藝家學做杯子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to learn to make cups from a potter?
entries.answer: 想，我想跟陶藝家學做自己的杯子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like a potter to teach me to make my own cup.

entries.example: 我太依賴手機了。
entries.exampleEnglish: I rely on my phone too much.
entries.question: 你很依賴手機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you depend a lot on your phone?
entries.answer: 很依賴，沒有手機我不能工作。
entries.answerEnglish: Very much; I can't work without my phone.

entries.example: 這家保險公司也承保旅遊平安險。
entries.exampleEnglish: This insurance company also underwrites travel insurance.
entries.question: 你買保險時，會注意哪家公司承保嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you buy insurance, do you check which company underwrites it?
entries.answer: 會，我會選大公司承保的保險。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I choose insurance underwritten by big companies.

entries.example: 魚在網子裡一直掙扎。
entries.exampleEnglish: The fish kept struggling in the net.
entries.question: 早上起床時，你會掙扎很久嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you struggle for a long time to get up in the morning?
entries.answer: 會，我每天早上都要掙扎很久才起床。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, every morning I struggle for ages before I get up.

entries.example: 下大雨不能出門，他很無奈。
entries.exampleEnglish: It was pouring and he couldn't go out; he felt helpless.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你覺得很無奈？
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you feel helpless?
entries.answer: 每天塞車讓我覺得很無奈。
entries.answerEnglish: Being stuck in traffic every day makes me feel helpless.

entries.example: 我要一杯可樂。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like a cola.
entries.question: 你喜歡喝可樂嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like drinking cola?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常喝可樂。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often drink cola.

entries.example: 瑞士現在還在用法郎。
entries.exampleEnglish: Switzerland still uses the franc.
entries.question: 你用過瑞士法郎嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever used Swiss francs?
entries.answer: 用過，我去瑞士旅行時用過法郎。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used francs when I traveled in Switzerland.

entries.example: 他口袋裡的零錢叮噹響。
entries.exampleEnglish: The coins in his pocket jingled.
entries.question: 你的包包裡有什麼會叮噹響？
entries.questionEnglish: What in your bag jingles?
entries.answer: 我的鑰匙圈走路時會叮噹響。
entries.answerEnglish: My key ring jingles when I walk.

entries.example: 這位國王被埋葬在金字塔裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: This king was buried in a pyramid.
entries.question: 古代的國王通常埋葬在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where were ancient kings usually buried?
entries.answer: 古代的國王通常埋葬在很大的陵墓裡。
entries.answerEnglish: Ancient kings were usually buried in huge tombs.

entries.example: 這部電影今晚在電視上播映。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is being shown on TV tonight.
entries.question: 你喜歡的節目什麼時候播映？
entries.questionEnglish: When is your favorite show broadcast?
entries.answer: 我喜歡的節目每週五晚上播映。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite show airs every Friday night.

entries.example: 這杯咖啡是十二盎司的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This coffee is a twelve-ounce cup.
entries.question: 你喝咖啡都買幾盎司的？
entries.questionEnglish: What size coffee, in ounces, do you usually buy?
entries.answer: 我都買十六盎司的大杯咖啡。
entries.answerEnglish: I always buy a large sixteen-ounce coffee.

entries.example: 非法入境的人會被遣返。
entries.exampleEnglish: People who enter illegally are sent back.
entries.question: 非法入境的人通常會怎麼樣？
entries.questionEnglish: What usually happens to people who enter a country illegally?
entries.answer: 非法入境的人通常會被遣返回國。
entries.answerEnglish: People who enter illegally are usually sent back to their home country.

entries.example: 股票跌到今年的最低點。
entries.exampleEnglish: The stock fell to its lowest point this year.
entries.question: 一天之中，你什麼時候精神在最低點？
entries.questionEnglish: When during the day is your energy at its lowest?
entries.answer: 下午三點左右，我的精神在最低點。
entries.answerEnglish: Around 3 p.m., my energy is at its lowest.

entries.example: 這道菜放了很多辣椒。
entries.exampleEnglish: This dish has a lot of chili in it.
entries.question: 你吃得了辣椒嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you handle chili?
entries.answer: 吃得了，我很喜歡吃辣椒。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love eating chili.

entries.example: 那名嫌犯被引渡回台灣。
entries.exampleEnglish: The suspect was extradited back to Taiwan.
entries.question: 什麼樣的人會被引渡回國？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of people get extradited back to their country?
entries.answer: 在國外犯罪的人可能會被引渡回國。
entries.answerEnglish: People who commit crimes abroad may be extradited home.

entries.example: 動物園裡有一座很大的鳥舍。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a huge aviary at the zoo.
entries.question: 你在動物園看過鳥舍嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen an aviary at a zoo?
entries.answer: 看過，木柵動物園的鳥舍很大。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the aviary at Muzha Zoo is huge.

entries.example: 台灣在1960年代開始工業化。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan began to industrialize in the 1960s.
entries.question: 你覺得工業化對環境好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think industrialization is good for the environment?
entries.answer: 不好，工業化讓空氣和水變髒了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, industrialization made the air and water dirty.

entries.example: 一杯珍奶有很多卡路里。
entries.exampleEnglish: A cup of bubble tea has a lot of calories.
entries.question: 你吃東西會算卡路里嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you count calories when you eat?
entries.answer: 不會，我從來不算卡路里。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I never count calories.

entries.example: 我們公司位於台北市中心。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company is located in downtown Taipei.
entries.question: 你家位於哪一區？
entries.questionEnglish: Which district is your home in?
entries.answer: 我家位於台北的大安區。
entries.answerEnglish: My home is in Da'an District, Taipei.

entries.example: 越南是一個開發中國家。
entries.exampleEnglish: Vietnam is a developing country.
entries.question: 你去過哪些開發中國家？
entries.questionEnglish: Which developing countries have you been to?
entries.answer: 我去過印尼和柬埔寨，它們都是開發中國家。
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Indonesia and Cambodia; both are developing countries.

entries.example: 我不再喝含糖飲料了。
entries.exampleEnglish: I don't drink sugary drinks anymore.
entries.question: 你有什麼東西不再用了？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you no longer use?
entries.answer: 我不再用現金，現在都用手機付錢。
entries.answerEnglish: I don't use cash anymore; now I pay with my phone.

entries.example: 我在家用個人電腦工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: I work on a PC at home.
entries.question: 你比較常用個人電腦還是手機？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a PC or your phone more?
entries.answer: 工作的時候我比較常用個人電腦。
entries.answerEnglish: I use a PC more when I'm working.

entries.example: 保險公司派了一位調查員來。
entries.exampleEnglish: The insurance company sent an investigator.
entries.question: 你覺得調查員的工作有趣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think an investigator's job is interesting?
entries.answer: 有趣，調查員可以到處去找真相。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, investigators get to go everywhere looking for the truth.

entries.example: 現在的經濟有很多不確定性。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a lot of uncertainty in the economy right now.
entries.question: 你怎麼面對工作上的不確定性？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you deal with uncertainty at work?
entries.answer: 我會多存一點錢，面對不確定性。
entries.answerEnglish: I save a bit more money to deal with uncertainty.

entries.example: 我們公司的休假制度很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company's leave system is very good.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的健保制度怎麼樣？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think of Taiwan's health insurance system?
entries.answer: 我覺得台灣的健保制度很方便。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taiwan's health insurance system is very convenient.

entries.example: 我們換了一家新的供應商。
entries.exampleEnglish: We switched to a new supplier.
entries.question: 你的工作需要跟供應商聯絡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your job involve contacting suppliers?
entries.answer: 需要，我每天都要跟供應商聯絡。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have to contact suppliers every day.

entries.example: 喔，原來是你！
entries.exampleEnglish: Oh, it's you!
entries.question: 朋友送你禮物，你會說什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you say when a friend gives you a gift?
entries.answer: 喔，好漂亮，謝謝你！
entries.answerEnglish: Ooh, it's so pretty, thank you!

entries.example: 他是一位手機遊戲的開發者。
entries.exampleEnglish: He is a mobile game developer.
entries.question: 你想當APP開發者嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be an app developer?
entries.answer: 想，我想當APP開發者，自己做遊戲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to be an app developer and make my own games.

entries.example: 立法院負責立法。
entries.exampleEnglish: The Legislative Yuan is responsible for making laws.
entries.question: 你覺得政府應該立法保護動物嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the government should pass laws to protect animals?
entries.answer: 應該，政府應該立法保護流浪動物。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the government should pass laws to protect stray animals.

entries.example: 這些錢都是納稅人的錢。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is all taxpayers' money.
entries.question: 在台灣工作，你也是納稅人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Working in Taiwan, are you a taxpayer too?
entries.answer: 是，我在台灣工作，也是納稅人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I work in Taiwan, so I'm a taxpayer too.

entries.example: 加一大匙醬油就好。
entries.exampleEnglish: Just add a tablespoon of soy sauce.
entries.question: 你炒菜會放幾大匙油？
entries.questionEnglish: How many tablespoons of oil do you use when stir-frying?
entries.answer: 我炒菜大概放一大匙油。
entries.answerEnglish: I use about one tablespoon of oil when I stir-fry.

entries.example: 湯裡再加一茶匙鹽。
entries.exampleEnglish: Add another teaspoon of salt to the soup.
entries.question: 你喝咖啡加幾茶匙糖？
entries.questionEnglish: How many teaspoons of sugar do you put in your coffee?
entries.answer: 我喝咖啡只加一茶匙糖。
entries.answerEnglish: I only put one teaspoon of sugar in my coffee.

entries.example: 現在不是買房子的好時機。
entries.exampleEnglish: Now isn't a good time to buy a house.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼時候是出國的好時機？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you think is a good time to travel abroad?
entries.answer: 我覺得秋天是出國旅行的好時機。
entries.answerEnglish: I think autumn is a good time to travel abroad.
